title: Members of Kid Rena's band and clarinetist Zeb
summary: French lists the band: Chester Zarder on bass, Zeb on clarinet, Morris, his father, and drummer Joe Rena; they discuss Zeb's age and origins.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: In the Renee's band? Let's see who was in the band. There was a banjo player, Chester Jones I know the bass player was in the band. Chester Jones was one and Zeb the Klanet player. Zeb. You might have heard talk about Zeb.
I think Chester Jones the one I know is a drummer. No it was Chester Zarder.
Oh Zarder. Chester Zarder. That was the bass player. Oh yes I know him too. And you had Renee and you had Morris and you had my daddy and you had the drummer. The drummer was Renee's brother.
Oh yes Joe, I've met him. Joe Renee.
He's a preacher now up on Jackson.
That's right. Well that was the band during those days. They had a very fine band.
Can you tell us anymore, don't interrupt you, while I think of it though, about Zeb? Because we hardly know his name. I never met him. He's before one of the time.

Well I remember Zeb from a little kid because he used to come home all the time. And Zeb was one of the fine client that player. That's what I hear he must have been good. He stayed with Renee for years.
Do you know how much older he was than you for instance? Do you know when he died or anything about him? Where he came from?

No, I think Zeb came from St. John's Pass. I'm not sure. But Zeb and my daddy, they were around the same age. Right now they'll be around about 80 years old. I figured they'd be around 80 years old. And Zeb, I mean pretty near all the fellas, he wasn't playing with Renee, he'd be playing with some band or another. He was a very fine client player.
See I guess Renee wouldn't be quite that old. He was just a couple years older than Louie.
I figured Renee would be around, I'll say about 65 now. Probably. Just about 65.
